title: Mara and the Deadline
author: C. M. Kavanagh
blurb: Yara Ishikawa, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, works cases no one wants attributed. Then a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must trade the one secret worth killing for before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
